CREATE TABLE dbo.copy_into_table
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(50),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(50),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(50),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(50),
    Units_Sold VARCHAR(50),
    Revenue VARCHAR(50)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
);

SELECT
    COLUMN_NAME,
    DATA_TYPE,
    CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'copy_into_table';


SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id) AS SchemaName,
    name AS TableName
FROM sys.tables
WHERE name = 'copyt_into_table';



COPY INTO dbo.copy_into_table
(
    Dealer_ID,
    Model_ID,
    Branch_ID,
    Date_ID,
    Units_Sold,
    Revenue
)
FROM 'https://azureadlsgen2storage.dfs.core.windows.net/raw/extrnl_table/'
WITH
(
    FILE_TYPE = 'PARQUET',
    CREDENTIAL = (IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity')
);

select * from copy_into_table;
